title: Configuration
accountFolderSuggestion: Folder proposed from the name; you can change it.
loggedInTitle: A local login marker exists; access has not been verified.
notLoggedInTitle: No local login marker was found.
loginUnknownTitle: Login may be kept somewhere the plugin does not read, such as the macOS Keychain.
accountSaveFirst: Save or reset your other changes first: this action reloads the page.
accountTerminalOpenedClaude: A terminal window was opened for this account. Type /login there if it asks, then choose Check login.
accountLoginHelp: Run this command in your terminal to log in, then check login again.
accountTerminalHint: Opens the client's own login in a terminal window for this account; the plugin never sees your password.
accountTerminalOpened: A terminal window was opened for this account. Log in there, then choose Check login.
accountTerminalNoTerminal: No terminal window could be opened here. Copy the command below and run it yourself.
accountTerminalUnsafeFolder: This account's folder name has characters the terminal launch does not accept. Copy the command below instead.
accountTerminalUnsupported: This client cannot be logged in from here. Copy the command below instead.
accountRemoveNote: Remove only changes the plugin's settings: the folder, the login and the history stay
